name: BACH_0260
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged tier 2; single-class conformal set, second model agrees, all five similar cases invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear single leader |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / OOD 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Tubule score well below typical [F3] · Weak
- **Little benign stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Benign background tissue scored scarce [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical in these regions · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction 71%** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Higher than 96% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions beats random removal by 0.54 logit (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses, the largest contributor here, is unreliable (0/20) [F2].

## Could be wrong if
- Concept support is overstated: mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) failed AI spot checks.
- The reliability score ranks errors modestly (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87), so a high score reassures only partly.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 10, 11:** Confirm stromal invasion and dense, variable tumor nuclei.
2. **Region 3:** Check whether glands or tubules are truly scarce.
3. **Regions 0, 5, 6:** Look for real mitoses; the mitosis score failed its spot check.

found: Bottom line says 'Read in turn', but the case is flagged for review (tier 2).
'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).

The second-model (MUSK) row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says whether the production classifier and the MUSK probe agree; the JSON does not say which class the MUSK probe chose.
